beats.summary: Michael discusses restrictions on his speech and humor at work, feeling frustrated about boundaries.

evidence.snippet: Michael: The problem is that I am the boss and apparently I can't say anything.
Michael: Where's the line? Where's the line, Jan.

beats.summary: Michael announces that he can no longer be friends and will only discuss work-related topics.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Attention, everyone! Hello! Ah, yes! I just want you to know that, uh, this is not my decision, but from here on out… we can no longer be friends.

beats.summary: Michael humorously declares he will no longer do any funny or witty things at work.

evidence.snippet:
Jan: You seem a little bit agitated, Michael. What's the problem?
Michael: The problem is that I am the boss and apparently I can't say anything.
Jan: Well, that… that's true in a way. You can't say anything.
Michael: Where's the line? Wher

beats.summary: Michael introduces his lawyer, James P. Albiny, as a protector for the company and management.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This guy does it all.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Does that include 'That's What She Said'?
